description: Registry of Authoritative Agricultural Research and Regulatory Institutions for MAITTRI Knowledge Base

institutions.name: Indian Council of Agricultural Research
institutions.name_hi: भारतीय कृषि अनुसंधान परिषद
institutions.scope: National agronomic standards, package of practices, and All India Coordinated Research Projects (AICRP)

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - भारतीय कृषि अनुसंधान संस्थान, नई दिल्ली
institutions.scope: Crop breeding, variety releases, integrated nutrient and pest management for North Indian plains

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research, Karnal
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - भारतीय गेहूं एवं जौ अनुसंधान संस्थान, करनाल
institutions.scope: Wheat and barley agronomy, stripe/yellow rust advisories, CRI irrigation timing, NEPZ and NWPZ varieties

institutions.name: ICAR - National Rice Research Institute, Cuttack
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - राष्ट्रीय चावल अनुसंधान संस्थान, कटक
institutions.scope: Rice cultivation, puddle vs direct seeded rice (DSR), Alternate Wetting & Drying (AWD), blast, sheath blight

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research, Ludhiana
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - भारतीय मक्का अनुसंधान संस्थान, लुधियाना
institutions.scope: Maize breeding, kharif/rabi hybrids, Fall Armyworm (FAW) IPM, moisture and whorl management

institutions.name: ICAR - Directorate of Rapeseed-Mustard Research, Bharatpur
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - सरसों अनुसंधान निदेशालय, भरतपुर
institutions.scope: Rapeseed and mustard package of practices, sulphur fertilization, aphid ETL thresholds, white rust management

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Potato Research Institute, Shimla
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय आलू अनुसंधान संस्थान, शिमला
institutions.scope: Potato seed tuber technology, Indo-Gangetic Plains potato cultivation, late blight forecast (JHULSACAST)

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Vegetable Research, Varanasi
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - भारतीय सब्जी अनुसंधान संस्थान, वाराणसी
institutions.scope: Tomato and vegetable production, ToLCV whitefly management, staking, fruit borer IPM in Uttar Pradesh

institutions.name: ICAR - Directorate of Weed Research, Jabalpur
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - खरपतवार अनुसंधान निदेशालय, जबलपुर
institutions.scope: Weed biology, herbicide resistance management, Phalaris minor, Echinochloa, weed seed bank suppression

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Soil Science, Bhopal
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - भारतीय मृदा विज्ञान संस्थान, भोपाल
institutions.scope: Soil health, macronutrient and micronutrient management, balanced fertilization, DAP and SSP arithmetic

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Soil Salinity Research Institute, Karnal
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय मृदा लवणता अनुसंधान संस्थान, करनाल
institutions.scope: Saline and sodic soil reclamation, gypsum requirement calculation, pyrite and green manuring

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Institute of Post-Harvest Engineering & Technology, Ludhiana
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय कटाई उपरांत अभियांत्रिकी एवं प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान
institutions.scope: Safe grain storage, moisture thresholds, hermetic bags, post-harvest losses mitigation

institutions.name: ICAR - Vivekananda Parvatiya Krishi Anusandhan Sansthan, Almora
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - विवेकानन्द पर्वतीय कृषि अनुसंधान संस्थान, अल्मोड़ा
institutions.scope: Mountain and hill farming, terrace cultivation, finger millet (Mandua), barnyard millet (Jhangora), hill pulses

institutions.name: Indian Grain Storage Management & Research Institute, Hapur
institutions.name_hi: भारतीय अनाज भंडारण प्रबंधन एवं अनुसंधान संस्थान, हापुड़
institutions.scope: Scientific grain warehousing, stored grain pest diagnostics (Ghun, Pulse beetle), phosphine fumigation safety

institutions.name: Central Insecticides Board & Registration Committee (CIBRC), Directorate of PPQ&S
institutions.name_hi: केंद्रीय कीटनाशक बोर्ड एवं पंजीकरण समिति, वनस्पति संरक्षण, संगरोध एवं संग्रह निदेशालय
institutions.scope: Statutory pesticide, fungicide, herbicide label approvals, crop x target authorization, dosage, PHI, waiting period

institutions.name: India Meteorological Department - Agromet Advisory Services Division
institutions.name_hi: भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग - कृषि मौसम विज्ञान प्रभाग
institutions.scope: District agromet advisories, frost/cold wave alerts, heat wave warnings, rain forecast for spray/irrigation scheduling

institutions.name: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture, GoI
institutions.name_hi: कृषि एवं किसान कल्याण विभाग, भारत सरकार
institutions.scope: National schemes: PM-KISAN, PMFBY crop insurance, PMKSY micro-irrigation, Soil Health Card portal guidelines

institutions.name: Agricultural Marketing Information Network (AGMARKNET), Directorate of Marketing & Inspection
institutions.name_hi: कृषि विपणन सूचना नेटवर्क (एगमार्कनेट)
institutions.scope: Daily wholesale minimum, maximum, and modal mandi prices, market arrivals, crop variety grade records

institutions.name: State Agricultural Universities of Uttar Pradesh (CSAUA&T Kanpur, ANDUA&T Ayodhya, SVPUA&T Meerut, BUAT Banda)
institutions.name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के राज्य कृषि विश्वविद्यालय
institutions.scope: State-specific package of practices, agro-climatic zone recommendations (Western, Central, Eastern, Bundelkhand UP)

institutions.name: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development & Reserve Bank of India
institutions.name_hi: नाबार्ड एवं भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक
institutions.scope: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Master Circulars, scale of finance, prompt repayment incentive (3% subvention)

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research, Kanpur
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - भारतीय दलहन अनुसंधान संस्थान, कानपुर
institutions.scope: Chickpea, lentil, and pigeonpea agronomy, wilt and dry root rot management, Bundelkhand pulse technology

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research, Lucknow
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - भारतीय गन्ना अनुसंधान संस्थान, लखनऊ
institutions.scope: Sugarcane trench planting, ratoon management, trash mulching, top borer and early shoot borer IPM

institutions.name: UP Council of Sugarcane Research, Shahjahanpur
institutions.name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश गन्ना शोध परिषद, शाहजहांपुर
institutions.scope: Sugarcane variety releases (Co-15023, Co-0118), Red Rot Pathotype CF-13 management, E-Ganna mill supply calendars

institutions.name: ICAR - Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research, Pune
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - प्याज एवं लहसुन अनुसंधान निदेशालय, पुणे
institutions.scope: Commercial onion production, nursery management, thrips tabaci IPM, purple blotch, curing and godown storage

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Soybean Research, Indore
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - भारतीय सोयाबीन अनुसंधान संस्थान, इंदौर
institutions.scope: Soybean production technology, Broad Bed Furrow (BBF) systems, Yellow Mosaic Virus whitefly vector, girdle beetle

institutions.name: ICAR - Directorate of Groundnut Research, Junagadh
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - मूंगफली अनुसंधान निदेशालय, जूनागढ़
institutions.scope: Groundnut agronomy, pegging gypsum application (250 kg/ha), collar rot, subterranean white grub, aflatoxin management

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research, Nagpur
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय कपास अनुसंधान संस्थान, नागपुर
institutions.scope: Bt cotton production, non-Bt refuge planting rules, pink bollworm pheromone monitoring, whitefly CLCuD management

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Research Institute for Dryland Agriculture, Hyderabad
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय बारानी कृषि अनुसंधान संस्थान, हैदराबाद
institutions.scope: District agriculture contingency plans for all 75 districts of UP, monsoon delays, mid-season dry spells, drought crops

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Institute of Agricultural Engineering, Bhopal
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय कृषि अभियांत्रिकी संस्थान, भोपाल
institutions.scope: Farm mechanization, Super Seeder calibration, Laser Land Leveler, Custom Hiring Center (CHC) machinery standards

institutions.name: National Horticulture Board, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
institutions.name_hi: राष्ट्रीय बागवानी बोर्ड, भारत सरकार
institutions.scope: Protected cultivation guidelines, Naturally Ventilated Polyhouse (NVPH) standards, commercial subsidies

institutions.name: Directorate General of Civil Aviation, Ministry of Civil Aviation, GoI
institutions.name_hi: नागर विमानन महानिदेशालय, भारत सरकार
institutions.scope: The Drone Rules 2021, Kisan drone Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC), DigitalSky green zone airspace clearances

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Agroforestry Research Institute, Jhansi
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय कृषि वानिकी अनुसंधान संस्थान, झांसी
institutions.scope: Commercial agroforestry systems, Poplar-wheat intercropping models, Clonal Eucalyptus boundary root barrier trenching

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Institute of Temperate Horticulture, Srinagar
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय समशीतोष्ण बागवानी संस्थान, श्रीनगर
institutions.scope: Temperate fruits, High-Density Apple Orchards (HDP M-9), chilling hours requirements, low-chill cultivars (HRMN-99)

institutions.name: ICAR - National Dairy Research Institute, Karnal
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - राष्ट्रीय डेयरी अनुसंधान संस्थान, करनाल
institutions.scope: Commercial dairy farming, Murrah buffalo & Sahiwal cattle nutrition, Total Mixed Ration (TMR), mastitis CMT screening

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Avian Research Institute, Izatnagar, Bareilly
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय पक्षी अनुसंधान संस्थान, इज्जत नगर, बरेली
institutions.scope: Backyard poultry farming, Kadaknath, Vanaraja, CARI Nirbheek breeds, artificial brooding, Ranikhet/IBD vaccination

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Institute of Freshwater Aquaculture, Bhubaneswar
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय मीठाजल जीवपालन अनुसंधान संस्थान, भुवनेश्वर
institutions.scope: Composite carp culture (Catla, Rohu, Mrigal), water quality & dissolved oxygen standards, CIFAX formulation for EUS

institutions.name: National Bee Board & Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
institutions.name_hi: राष्ट्रीय मधुमक्खी बोर्ड, भारत सरकार
institutions.scope: Commercial Apis mellifera apiculture, North Indian floral migration calendars, organic Varroa mite suppression (Formic acid)

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research, Lucknow
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - भारतीय गन्ना अनुसंधान संस्थान, लखनऊ
institutions.scope: Sugarcane agronomy, autumn/spring planting, trench method, red rot resistance, ratoon management

institutions.name: ICAR - National Research Centre for Banana, Tiruchirappalli
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - राष्ट्रीय केला अनुसंधान केंद्र, तिरुचिरापल्ली
institutions.scope: Banana cultivation packages, Grand Naine spacing, drip fertigation, bunch management, Panama wilt prevention

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture, Lucknow
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय उपोष्ण बागवानी संस्थान, लखनऊ
institutions.scope: Subtropical horticulture, high-density mango and guava, rejuvenation pruning, malformation management

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Institute for Research on Buffaloes, Hisar
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय भैंस अनुसंधान संस्थान, हिसार
institutions.scope: Murrah buffalo breeding, nutrition, dairy reproduction, semen cryopreservation, mastitis management

institutions.name: ICAR - Directorate of Poultry Research, Hyderabad
institutions.name_hi: आईसीएआर - कुक्कुट अनुसंधान निदेशालय, हैदराबाद
institutions.scope: Rural and backyard poultry breeds (Vanaraja, Gramapriya, Srinidhi), health protocols, feed formulation

institutions.name: Forest Research Institute (ICFRE), Dehradun
institutions.name_hi: वन अनुसंधान संस्थान, देहरादून
institutions.scope: Commercial agroforestry, Poplar and Eucalyptus clonal plantations, spacing geometries, rabi intercropping
